hooks.name: Check Python source changes
hooks.description: Runs Ruff and fail-fast pytest whenever a current Kiro mutation tool changes Python source or tests, while preserving the PostToolUse JSON payload on stdin.

action.command: .venv/bin/python -c 'import json, subprocess, sys; payload = json.load(sys.stdin); text = json.dumps(payload); changed = any(marker in text for marker in ("src/", "src\\/", "tests/", "tests\\/")); ruff = subprocess.run([".venv/bin/ruff", "check", "src", "tests"]).returncode if changed else 0; tests = subprocess.run([".venv/bin/pytest", "-x", "-q"]).returncode if changed else 0; sys.exit(ruff or tests)'
